title: Manali, Jispa & Sissu
reportingPoint: Departure is in the evening from Delhi or Chandigarh. Final pickup details are shared with confirmed travellers before the trip; report at the pickup point 30 minutes early.
overview:
A high-altitude road trip: this **2 Nights / 3 Days** weekend trip leaves Delhi or Chandigarh in the evening in an AC vehicle for an overnight journey to Manali.

Day 1 covers Hadimba Temple, Old Manali and Mall Road, with cafe hopping in Old Manali. Day 2 is the big drive: through the Atal Tunnel into Lahaul, past Keylong and Jispa to Baralacha Pass (weather permitting) and Suraj Taal lake, then back to a camp in Keylong. Day 3 stops at Sissu on the way back to Manali (boating on Sissu Lake is optional and extra) before the evening departure; you reach Delhi or Chandigarh the next morning. Prices start at ₹8,000 per person on quad sharing (5% GST extra), the same for all batches.
highlights: Hadimba Temple, Old Manali and Mall Road
Drive through the Atal Tunnel into Lahaul Valley
Sissu, with optional boating on Sissu Lake

itinerary.title: Departure from Delhi / Chandigarh
itinerary.content:
Assemble at the pickup point in Delhi or Chandigarh, meet your team captain and the group.
Depart in the evening for the overnight journey to Manali in an AC vehicle.
Halt for dinner on the way (not included).

itinerary.title: Reach Manali | Hadimba Temple | Old Manali | Mall Road
itinerary.content:
Reach Manali in the morning, check in at the hotel and freshen up.
Local sightseeing: Hadimba Temple, Old Manali and Mall Road.
Cafe hopping in Old Manali.
Back at the hotel for dinner and overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Atal Tunnel | Jispa | Baralacha Pass | Suraj Taal | Keylong
itinerary.content:
Breakfast and check out from the hotel.
Drive through the Atal Tunnel into Lahaul Valley, then on past Keylong and Jispa to Baralacha Pass (weather permitting) and Suraj Taal lake.
Return to Keylong and check in to the camp.
Dinner and overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Sissu | Back to Manali | Departure
itinerary.content:
Wake up early, have breakfast and check out.
Drive back towards Manali, stopping at Sissu for the scenery. Boating on Sissu Lake is optional (charges not included).
Reach Manali by evening, visit Mall Road if time permits, then depart.
Reach Delhi or Chandigarh the next morning.

includes: Stay: 1 night in a hotel in Manali and 1 night in a camp in Keylong
Transfers to and from in an AC vehicle
All sightseeing mentioned in the itinerary
excludes: Food and beverages not included in the package
Costs from natural calamities or circumstances beyond our control
Any other expense not listed under the inclusions

faqs.q: Where and when does the trip start?
faqs.a: The trip leaves Delhi or Chandigarh in the evening for an overnight journey to Manali in an AC vehicle. Final pickup details are shared with confirmed travellers before the trip.

faqs.q: How much does the Manali, Jispa & Sissu trip cost?
faqs.a: ₹8,000 per person on quad sharing, ₹8,500 on triple sharing and ₹9,000 on double sharing. 5% GST is extra.
1 night in a Manali hotel and 1 night in a Keylong camp, 4 meals (2 breakfasts and 2 dinners), AC transport both ways, all sightseeing in the itinerary and a tour curator.

faqs.q: Will we definitely reach Baralacha Pass?
faqs.a: Baralacha Pass is visited weather permitting. Lahaul gets very cold, so pack thermals, a down jacket, gloves and socks.
Night 1 is in a hotel in Manali and night 2 in a camp in Keylong. Extra mattresses are provided for triple and quad sharing.

faqs.q: How do I book and pay?
faqs.a: Reserve your seat with a ₹3,000 advance per person (UPI, GPay, PhonePe, Paytm or net banking) and pay the rest 24 hours before boarding. 5% GST is extra on the trip price.
The ₹3,000 advance is not refunded under any circumstances. There are no refunds for inclusions you don't use, and bookings can't be transferred.

faqs.q: What do I need to carry?
faqs.a: A valid government photo ID is a must: there is no boarding without it. Also pack a down or main jacket, thermals, socks and gloves, outdoor shoes, a daypack and personal medication. The full list is under Things To Pack.

thingsToCarry: Valid government photo ID (no boarding without it)
